verdict.rationale: Statsig supports guarding rollouts with metrics via scheduled/gradual feature-gate rollouts, experiment scorecards with primary/secondary metrics and confidence-interval lift reporting, and Infra Analytics alerts to 'catch regressions' alongside an emergency manual disable switch for a gate. However, there is no evidence of an automated rollback mechanism that reverts a release when a regression is detected — rollback appears to require manual intervention (the 'emergency disable switch') rather than automatic triggering from a metrics guardrail. Missing for 10: documented auto-rollback/guardrail-metric-triggered rollback feature, evidence of automatic gate disable tied to statistical regression detection, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
